name: lc-admin-ui
description: The small amount of TypeScript the Lightcone administration console needs.

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run check:vendor && npm run bundle
scripts.check:vendor: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),o='static/vendor/htmx.min.js',p='node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js';if(!fs.readFileSync(o).equals(fs.readFileSync(p))){console.error(o+' is not the htmx that package-lock.json pins. Run: npm run vendor');process.exit(1)}"
